question_summary: Subcontractor requests approval to substitute ABS DWV piping in place of specified no-hub cast-iron soil piping (Section 22 13 16) prior to placing material order.
proposed_solution: Use ABS DWV piping as an alternate to the specified no-hub cast-iron soil piping.
deadline_text: A response by the end of the day would let us keep the order on track.
routing_rationale: As a substitution request with no stated cost impact, it defaults to the design professional of record for the plumbing discipline for approval.
